newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,6-,9-mo down, 12-mo same.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,6-,9-mo down, 12-mo same.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-, six- and nine- month treasury bills slipped and 12-month treasury bills were the same compared with last sales, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The debut of 18-month bills, scheduled for April 3, was rescheduled for Friday.

Three-month bills edged down to 24.24 percent from 24.43 percent, six-month bills slipped to 30.68 percent from 30.71 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 34.45 percent from 34.75 percent, and 12-month bills were unchanged at 39.56 percent.
The results of Thursdsay's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 1.56 million UAH 1.16 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.47 million UAH 1.09 million UAH
The central bank sold 15,616 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 32 were competitive and 15,584 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 4.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 35.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 3.75 million UAH 9.04 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.25 million UAH 7.84 million UAH
The central bank sold 37,520 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 31,686 were competitive and 5,834 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 4.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 45.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 1.87 million UAH 2.25 million UAH
Actual amount raised 1.49 million UAH 1.78 million UAH
The central bank sold 18,726 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 17,466 were competitive and 1,260 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 4.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 55.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 3.61 million UAH 27.81 million UAH
Actual amount raised 2.59 million UAH 19.94 million UAH
The central bank sold 36,140 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 30,560 were competitive and 5,580 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 4.
